text: The products kanban and the FS board (/kanban/financial-mediation) share this service: PRO-9859 (commit 174937e3d) changed it for product boards and the FS board stopped loading products (PRO-9977). A change here must be checked on both boards.
author: bohdantanasov

text: 'Remove from KANBAN' on the FS board goes through tRPC financialMediationKanban.removeFromKanban; PRO-9641 (commit 2f96e520d) reshaped its input DTO and the mutation failed with 500 (PRO-10005). Changing RemoveFromKanbanInput or the service it calls breaks card removal and blacklisting.
author: bohdantanasov
